# Eating on 30A

> Restaurant guide for Scenic Highway 30A in Walton County, Florida.

Eating on 30A is a restaurant guide for Scenic Highway 30A in South Walton. Find breakfast, lunch, and dinner from Dune Allen to Inlet Beach, with the address, the hours, and a feel for the place.

Each profile gives the street address and a map pin. A photograph appears when the listing has one.

## Restaurants

- [3 Sons Bar-B-Q](https://www.eatingon30a.com/restaurants/3-sons-bar-b-q-dune-allen-beach/): 6931 W County Hwy 30A, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459, USA. BBQ, American; Lunch, Dinner. 3 Sons Bar-B-Q smokes brisket, ribs, pork, and chicken on County Highway 30A in Dune Allen. The pit is open daily, with an afternoon happy hour.
- [3rd Cup](https://www.eatingon30a.com/restaurants/3rd-cup-rosemary-beach/): 3 Main St, Rosemary Beach, FL 32461, USA. American, Cafe; Breakfast. 3rd Cup is a cozy coffee shop perfect for a morning stop. Relaxed and welcoming.
- [87 Central Square](https://www.eatingon30a.com/restaurants/87-central-square-seaside/): 87 Central Square, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459, USA. American; Lunch, Dinner. 87 Central Square is a Seaside gathering spot on Central Square. The bar opens at 11am and the dining room at 4pm.
- [98 Bar-B-Que](https://www.eatingon30a.com/restaurants/98-bar-b-que/): 5008 US Hwy 98 W, Unit 1, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459, USA. BBQ; Lunch, Dinner. 98 Bar-B-Que serves smoked barbecue and gumbo for lunch and dinner on US 98. The dining room can take large parties.
- [Aja 30A](https://www.eatingon30a.com/restaurants/aja-30a-inlet-beach/): 12805 US-98 Suite T101, Inlet Beach, FL 32461, USA. Asian, Japanese; Lunch, Dinner. Aja 30A serves elevated Asian dishes and sushi at 30Avenue in Inlet Beach. It is a dinner restaurant.
- [AJ’s Grayton Beach](https://www.eatingon30a.com/restaurants/ajs-grayton-beach-grayton-beach/): 63 Defuniak St, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459, USA. Seafood, American; Lunch, Dinner. AJ’s Grayton Beach combines seafood, drinks, and live music in a high-energy setting. A popular destination for nightlife and dining.

- [Amavida Coffee Roasters](https://www.eatingon30a.com/restaurants/amavida-coffee-roasters-rosemary-beach/): 104 N Barrett Square, Rosemary Beach, FL 32461, USA. American, Cafe; Breakfast. Amavida Coffee Roasters serves high-quality coffee in a casual café setting. A local favorite.
- [Ambrosia](https://www.eatingon30a.com/restaurants/ambrosia-watersound-origins/): 75 Origins Main St, Watersound, FL 32461, USA. American; Lunch, Dinner. Ambrosia offers upscale dining with a refined menu. A great choice for dinner.

- [Angelina’s Pizzeria & Pasta](https://www.eatingon30a.com/restaurants/angelinas-pizzeria-and-pasta-seagrove-beach/): 4005 E County Hwy 30A, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459, USA. Italian; Lunch, Dinner. Angelina’s offers Italian favorites like pasta and pizza in a relaxed environment. Great for family dining.

Basmati’s Asian Cuisine delivers fresh, refined Asian dishes in an upscale setting. Perfect for a quieter dinner experience.

## Towns

- [Dune Allen Beach](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/dune-allen-beach/): Explore the full stretch of 30A, from laid-back beach towns to vibrant coastal communities, all in one place.
- [Gulf Place](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/gulf-place/): A vibrant hub on the west end of 30A with colorful architecture, local shops, live music, and easy beach access.
- [Blue Mountain Beach](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/blue-mountain-beach/): A relaxed beach town with local eats and a friendly community.
- [Grayton Beach](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/grayton-beach/): A laid-back, artsy beach town with pristine beaches and local flavor.
- [WaterColor](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/watercolor/): Upscale and family-friendly with beautiful beaches and scenic trails.
- [Seaside](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/seaside/): The iconic heart of 30A. Charming, walkable, and full of coastal character.
- [Seagrove Beach](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/seagrove-beach/): A laid-back, tree-lined beach community with a mix of old Florida charm and modern coastal living.
- [Seacrest](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/seacrest/): A peaceful retreat with sugar-white sands and easy access to fun.
- [Watersound](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/watersound/): A beach stretch east of Seagrove, with casual dining along County Highway 30A.
- [Alys Beach](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/alys-beach/): Striking architecture, upscale shopping, and a peaceful beachfront vibe.
- [Rosemary Beach](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/rosemary-beach/): European-inspired charm with cobblestone streets and a vibrant atmosphere.
- [Inlet Beach](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/inlet-beach/): Trendy, up-and-coming, and close to the action.
- [Watersound Origins](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/watersound-origins/): An inland town center north of 30A, with everyday restaurants around the square.
- [Nearby](https://www.eatingon30a.com/areas/nearby/): Everyday dining on the US 98 plazas, a short drive from Scenic Highway 30A.
